description: Logistic science from iron and copper plates: cable, circuit, gear, inserter and belt assemblers feed six science assemblers
notes: assembling-machine-2 -> assembling-machine-1 and fast-inserter -> inserter (v1 tier, D20)
the two inserters that picked from the neighbouring tile's bus (east edge) became belt ports: copper (row 0) and iron (row 5)

B25: the tileable pass-throughs no longer run off the west edge (they would spill copper and iron onto belts passing the module): the copper belt (row 0) turns south into the cable inserter at its end, and the west end tiles of rows 5 and 7 (nothing picks from them) are removed; the science belt (row 6) is the output port
not expandable: the feeder block (cable, circuit, gear, inserter, belt assemblers) is not periodic and every cut through it breaks a direct-insertion link; grow by placing another copy
